Name: Data Layers
Author: Pathoschild
Description:
Overlay the world with visual data like bee/Junimo/scarecrow/sprinkler coverage, hidden paths and warps, and more. It automatically includes data from other mods if applicable.

[b][color=#6aa84f][b][color=#6aa84f]For non-English players, translations are included in the base mod. [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods#translating-the-mods]Contributions are welcome[/url]![/color][/b][/color][/b]


[size=6][b]Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=6][b]How to use[/b][/size]
Press [font=Courier New]F2[/font] to show the overlay, and then [font=Courier New][left CTRL][/font] and [font=Courier New][right CTRL][/font] to cycle between data layers (buttons configurable). For coverage layers (e.g. scarecrows or sprinklers), point at one with the cursor to see a blue border around that one's range and a green border around the coverage without it.

You can optionally [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/tree/stable/DataLayers#configure]customise the options[/url]. That includes keyboard/controller bindings, and hiding layers you don't want.


[size=6][b]Current layers[/b][/size]
[size=4]Auto[/size]
Automatically chooses an overlay based on context like the item you're holding, with live updates when that changes. You can configure which layers can be shown that way.
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/refs/heads/stable/DataLayers/docs/screenshots/auto-layer.png[/img]

[size=4]Accessible[/size]
Shows where you can walk and highlights warp tiles; useful for finding hidden paths and nooks, or testing custom maps.
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/DataLayers/docs/screenshots/accessible.png[/img]

[size=4]Buildable[/size]
Shows where you can construct buildings on the farm. Useful for spotting issues before you try to build at Robin's, or testing custom maps.
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/DataLayers/docs/screenshots/buildable.png[/img]

[size=4]Coverage: bee houses[/size]
Shows bee houses' flower search range.
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/DataLayers/docs/screenshots/bee-houses.png[/img]

[size=4]Coverage: bombs[/size]
Shows bombs' explosion radius, including the three different effects (where they'll dig, destroy objects, and hurt monsters/players).
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/DataLayers/docs/screenshots/bombs.png[/img]

[size=4]Coverage: Junimo huts[/size]
Shows Junimo hut coverage, and highlights crops they won't reach. Also works when placing a Junimo hut from the Wizard's build menu.
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/DataLayers/docs/screenshots/junimo-huts.png[/img]

[size=4]Coverage: scarecrows[/size]
Shows scarecrow coverage, and highlights unprotected crops. Also works on scarecrows being placed.
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/DataLayers/docs/screenshots/scarecrows.png[/img]

[size=4]Coverage: sprinklers[/size]
Shows sprinkler coverage, and highlights unsprinkled crops. Also works on sprinklers being placed.
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/DataLayers/docs/screenshots/sprinklers.png[/img]

[size=4]Crops: fertilized[/size]
Shows which crops have fertilizer applied.
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/DataLayers/docs/screenshots/crops-fertilized.png[/img]

[size=4]Crops: watered[/size]
Shows which crops have been watered today.
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/DataLayers/docs/screenshots/crops-watered.png[/img]

[size=4]Crops: ready for harvest[/size]
Shows which crops are ready to harvest, or which won't be ready before they die due to a season change.
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/DataLayers/docs/screenshots/crops-harvest.png[/img]

[size=4]Crops: water for paddy crops[/size]
Shows which tiles are close enough to water for paddy crops to get auto-watered and bonus growth.
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/DataLayers/docs/screenshots/crops-paddy-water.png[/img]

[size=4]Fishing depth
[/size]Shows the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Fishing#Distance_from_Land]fishing depth[/url] of each water tile, to help with fishing strategy.
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/DataLayers/docs/screenshots/fishing-depth.png[/img]
[size=4]
Machine processing[/size]
Shows whether your machines are empty, processing, or finished.

When [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url] is installed, this includes all non-standard machine types it supports (e.g. buildings, bushes, trees, machines added via Producer Framework Mod, etc).
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/DataLayers/docs/screenshots/machines.png[/img]

[size=4]Tillable[/size]
Shows where you can till dirt with your hoe. Useful for planning crop layouts, or testing custom maps.
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/DataLayers/docs/screenshots/tillable.png[/img]

[size=4]Grid[/size]
The grid layer shows [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Modder_Guide/Game_Fundamentals#Tiles]tile borders[/url] useful for planning layouts, calculating fishing distance, etc:
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/DataLayers/docs/screenshots/grid-layer.png[/img]

You can optionally [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/tree/stable/DataLayers#configuration]edit the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] file[/url] to enable the grid for all layers instead:
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/DataLayers/docs/screenshots/grid-option.png[/img]


[size=6][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][list]
[*]Compatible with...[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later;
[*]Linux, macOS, and Windows;
[*]single-player and multiplayer.
[/list]
[*]No known mod conflicts.
[/list]
Data Layers automatically supports these mods if they're installed:
[list]
[*]Automate — shows whether your machines are empty, processing, or ready to harvest.
[*]Better Junimos﻿ ﻿— shows custom Junimo hut range.
[*]Better Sprinklers﻿ — shows custom sprinkler range.
[*]Cobalt ﻿— shows cobalt sprinkler range.
[*]Pelican Fiber ﻿— shows coverage when building a Junimo hut or sprinkler through Pelican Fiber's menu.
[*]Prismatic Tools — shows prismatic sprinkler/scarecrow range.
[*]Simple Sprinkler — shows custom sprinkler range.
[/list]
